1. Do not open the app again; uninstall it (deactivate device admin first if asked).
2. Change passwords of WhatsApp, email, mobile banking and e-wallets, from another phone if you can.
3. Turn two-step verification back on and log out other devices.
4. Call your bank through its official number if OTP codes may have been read.
5. Dial *#21# to check call forwarding and ##002# to cancel it.
